name: Fragment's Note
source:
After school, on the rooftop, drenched in the color of the setting sun...

Yukiha Tenjo confesses his love to his childhood friend and longtime crush...and gets rejected. 
Suddenly, a young girl named Miu appears out of nowhere, claiming to be his "daughter from the future".

"I will protect you... Daddy, and everyone else too."

As he spends time with Miu, the cruel fate that awaits him slowly becomes clear.

"After all, the future is something that is shaped by the decisions you make."

Yukiha must make a choice. So he grants his daughter's wish. So he can build a new future with the ones he holds dear... 

This is the story of Yukiha Tenjo.

[From [url=https://fragmentsnote-plus.ullucus.com/en/]Fragment's Note+ official website[/url]]
translation:
放学后的天台，沐浴在夕阳的色彩中……天上雪叶向他暗恋已久的青梅竹马表白了……然后被拒绝了。突然，一个名叫美雨的少女不知从哪里出现，声称自己是"来自未来的女儿"。"我会保护你的……爸爸，还有其他所有人。"随着与美雨相处，等待着他的残酷命运逐渐变得清晰。"毕竟，未来是由你做出的决定所塑造的。"雪叶必须做出选择。于是他满足了女儿的愿望。为了能和珍视的人们一起创造新的未来……这是天上雪叶的故事。

[来自[url=https://fragmentsnote-plus.ullucus.com/en/]Fragment's Note+ 官方网站[/url]]
